g.text: States of one queue collection (head-only matching, decision 11)
the head waiter does not match
the head record, so nothing fires
receive that fires with the head:
the head leaves, or stays for a peek
send that fires the head waiter:
the waiter leaves, or stays if persistent
also a peek and a fire that changes no state
A send meets the head waiter only when R is empty.
A receive meets the head record only when W is empty.
Re-offer: a peek waiter leaves the datum alive,
and the next round offers it to the next head waiter.
Drain: a persistent receive meets the next head record.
Re-issue: a divergent pair (a send !! with a receive <=,
or a receive <= with a record of !!) re-issues after
one round, and any chain re-issues after 64 fires (I-21).
not opened: the collection has no counter yet
stored state of the collection: records, waiters, counter
blocked: both sides wait behind heads that do not match
